evidence: A Dagger user praises consistent local and CI workflows, remote caching, and reusable SDKs.

evidence_sources.author: verdverm
evidence_sources.excerpt: Yes, I use Dagger, it's much more than building containers - Container based workflows are the same in CI and locally (you can run containers too), they become one-liners - Remote caching out of the box without extra steps - Multiple language SDKs, unlocks the DAG in BuildKit and containers, real reuse

source_story_title: Roku developer repositories moved from GitHub to GitLab
